description: One of Lebanon's largest banks by branch network, full-service retail/corporate/private banking, part of the wider Fransabank Group (incl. Fransabank France, regional subsidiaries) and majority owner of BLC Bank. Listed on CMA Lebanon's approved-institutions register. Group Chairman & CEO: Adnan Kassar; Chairman-General Manager of Fransabank S.A.L. specifically: Nadim Kassar.

fit.reasoning: Fit: priority segment bank (20) + Lebanon (15) + multi-asset via group's cross-border retail/corporate/investment activity (10) + third-party deposits and private banking (10) + BDL/CMA regulated (5) = 60/60. Timing: sector-wide Law 23/2025 restructuring pressure (10/25) - not scored as a positive trigger specifically for Fransabank because no individual viable/recapitalising confirmation was found; survivor-vs-resolution status unconfirmed and is the gating question. Access: two named leaders (Adnan Kassar, Group Chairman/CEO; Nadim Kassar, Chairman-GM of the SAL entity) but no direct contact route found = 3/15. Total mechanically ~73, held to 52 pending viability-track confirmation - do not treat as outreach-ready.
